# MDP

> A presentation compiler for AI-written content. One declarative .mdp source compiles, deterministically, into design-locked artifacts: a page, a slide deck, a flyer, the document forms (report, one-pager, memo, letter), and the interactive forms (scroll, accordion, tabs, stepper). The author writes meaning; the engine owns all design.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what MDP is, quick start, the block list.
- [SPEC](SPEC.md): the .mdp format and how a source maps to each artifact.
- [VISION](VISION.md): the architecture and the extensibility model.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): how to build, run, and extend the engine.

## Examples

- [block-stats.mdp](examples/block-stats.mdp): a stats band with a cited quote.
- [block-compare.mdp](examples/block-compare.mdp): the full block set (compare, flow, callouts).
- [rtl.mdp](examples/rtl.mdp): a right-to-left document (`dir: rtl`).
- [examples/README.md](examples/README.md): the full, generated index of probes.
- [templates/README.md](templates/README.md): fill-in starters by document type.

## Use in agent tools

MDP ships to agent tools three ways: a Claude Code plugin (a `/mdp` command), a Codex plugin (an `mdp` skill, self-contained in `codex/`), and an MCP server (`mdp-mcp` in `packages/mcp/`, run via `npx -y mdp-mcp`) exposing `mdp_compile`, `mdp_present`, `mdp_validate`, and `mdp_send_slack` to any MCP host (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ...). The agent authors `.mdp`, runs the bundled engine, and opens the result. Same engine, no styling in the source any way.

## Authoring MDP

An .mdp file is valid Markdown plus a few typed blocks. There is no styling in the source; the engine composes the design.

- Frontmatter: `mdp: 1`, `forms: [page, slides, flyer]`, `title`, optional `kicker`, `lang`, `dir`, `theme` (a named theme), `brand-logo` (an asset reference), `brand-accent` and optional `brand-accent-2` (one 6-digit hex each; the engine derives a full AA-gated accent set), `brand-font` (the body font: one of system, serif, mono, rounded, humanist).
- `# Title`, then `{.lead} a standfirst`. Sections start with `## Heading`. A line that is exactly `---` is a section or slide break.
- Lists with `- ` or `1. `. A quote with `> ...` and an optional `{.cite} attribution`.
- `mdp:stats` (key: value lines), `mdp:compare` (options as `# Name` plus `badge:`, `note:`, `cta:`, and `- ` pros), `mdp:flow` (steps joined by `->`), and `:::callout <variant>` ... `:::`.
- Never put styling in the source: no sizes, no inline CSS, no arbitrary fonts. The only color you may set is `brand-accent` (a hex the engine derives and gates to WCAG AA), and the only font is `brand-font` from a fixed set of system stacks; otherwise pick a named `theme`.
